rationale: The visually verified original lists shiitake in one pooled food event and separately enumerates the Parkinson cases. No food-to-diagnosis linkage, cooking preparation or comparative swallowing measure is provided.

Topical tarragon extract gave a lower immediate WOMAC pain score after treatment. Later overall comparisons were inconclusive. Schedule, allocation method and masking details conflict with the prospective registration, and the study concerns osteoarthritis rather than culinary Parkinson pain.

The primary author abstract reports a longer acute on-period in the ground-soy levodopa comparison. A secondary review adds unverified preparation and duration details and disagrees with the original on drug amount and metabolite directions. Daily OFF time and refined soybean oil were unmeasured.
